title: santaloides microphylla
intro: Santaloides microphylla, commonly known as the 'Mountain Sandlewood', is a type of plant species that belongs to the Santalaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Santaloides microphylla include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal agent, making it useful for treating various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, diterpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
